other_recordings_used: Each recording was used to check the other: 021327 and 022627 (both Sep 8 2026, one hour apart) independently give the same 20-card multiset, so one list covers both. No third recording was needed.

completeness_check.method: Deck-count arithmetic from the Codex ledgers (20-card deck, 5-card opening hand, draws, Copycat/Sightseer/Researcher/Research counts).
completeness_check.022627: Direct observation: the turn 13 draw fails with 'No cards left in deck' (accepted review turn 13; TURN_LEDGER turn 13 failed_normal). Arithmetic reaches exactly 0 cards after the turn 11 draw. The last three cards in the deck at turn 7 (Sightseer view) were Pokémon Flute, gold Raticate ex and full-art Professor's Research, all already counted. The turn 7 Poké Ball found no Basic in the deck, so the deck holds exactly 5 Basics (Comfey, 2 Rattata, 2 Drowzee), all seen.
completeness_check.021327: Arithmetic (no direct empty-deck observation): 15 cards left after the opening hand; turn 2 draw 1 and Research 2 leave 12; turn 4 draw 1 (Researcher tails) leaves 11; turn 6 draw 1 and Research 2 leave 8; turn 8 draw 1 and the Sightseer take of Hypno leave 6; turn 10 draw 1 leaves 5, Copycat shuffles 1 card back (6) and draws 5, leaving exactly 1 card, which is the Cyrus drawn in turn 12 (deck then 0). Both turn 10 Poké Balls found no Basic in the deck.
completeness_check.result: Every one of the 20 physical cards of the deck was drawn and identified in each recording, so no slot is inferred. The identification relies on the Codex ledger being right about names and counts.

caveats: Treat as approximate: the exact historical 20-card list was never stored. This list is derived only from cards seen in the two recordings; the repo list decks/dustin/14-comfey-raticate-hypno.txt happens to hold the same 20 cards by name and count but was NOT used as proof, only as the format and id template.

Printings: the recordings show alternate art (full-art or gold-art Raticate ex, Drowzee, Hypno, Comfey; regular and full-art Professor's Research). Alternate arts are the same playable card. Ids are the first printing from card_ids.py for the Pokémon and the repo's usual ids for Poké Ball (P-A 005) and Professor's Research (P-A 007); the engine plays any printing of a card the same way.

Who went first: in 021327 Dustin went second (accepted review and ledger turn 1 is the opponent). In 022627 he went FIRST (he won the opening flip; ledger turn 1 is Dacz8976), not second as the task header said.

Counts rest on the Codex retrospective ledgers (hands and draws) and the accepted reviews; both flag some disagreements on energy targets and timing, none of which changes a card count. The accepted 021327 review says a Poké Ball found Drowzee in turn 10; the newer ledger says Drowzee came from the Copycat draw. Either way two Poké Balls were played that turn.
Game mode (ladder vs Auto) is uncertain in both packets; this does not affect the card list.
Opponent cards (Jigglypuff, Mewtwo ex, Skorupi, Drapion, Mega Absol ex, Hydreigon, Lillie, Lucky Ice Pop and so on) are not part of this deck and are excluded.
